prediction: global mean + user bias + recipe bias + user factor dot (free recipe factor + alpha*(0.5 mean mapped-ingredient factor + 0.5 mean direct-FoodOn factor))
empty_feature_policy: an empty family mean is the zero vector; never infer ingredient absence
training_objective: observed-entry mean squared error plus regularization on indexed user/free-item factors, user/item biases, and mean ingredient/concept representations
selection: highest mean validation NDCG@10 over users with a positive validation target; ties lower clipped validation RMSE, lower content scale, greater regularization, earlier epoch
ranking: full 75972 catalog minus each user's 28 train recipes; any recipe with a train rating or a supervised ingredient/direct concept factor is scoreable; other recipes follow as fallback by train-positive popularity then numeric recipe ID
boundary: retrospective supplementary semantic MF comparison against the interaction-only MF baseline; validation-selected with no new test access
